title: swelter alerts feed payload
description: The Python↔JS contract for `/api/alerts.json` and `web/alerts.json` — public, aggregate danger-threshold crossings, no PII. Emitted by `alerts.AlertFeed.to_json` (src/swelter/alerts.py); consumed by `web/app.js` `activeAlerts()` / `renderAlerts()`. A deliberate field change on either side must edit this schema and both validating tests in the same PR (FIX-07).

thresholds.description: The active hazard pack's danger floors, keyed by floor id. Which keys are present depends on the pack (heat: pm25_aqi, heat_index_c, exposure; cold: pm25_aqi, wind_chill_c), so only the always-watched air-quality floor is required.

stale.description: Published cells that have stopped reporting: swelter cannot tell whether they are currently safe. An empty `alerts` array means no *currently reporting* cell crossed a floor, not that every cell is fine — these are the cells it cannot see (ADR 0035).

history_context.description: Where this hour's value sits in this same area's own recorded distribution for the same calendar month (#241) — the same object the surface record carries. `null` whenever no percentile may be published honestly, and then `history_context_reason` says which of three reasons applies.

basis.description: `raw` means the baseline is not calibrated-only, and the rendered sentence says so.

history_context_reason.description: Why there is no `history_context`, when there is none. Three codes rather than one, because only `thin_history` is resolved by recording more hours.

staleArea.description: One cell/parameter with no reading in the feed's bucket. Carries no value on purpose: the last reading is not a measurement of now, so there is no `value`, `severity`, or `aqi` field a consumer could read as the current condition.

hours_since_last_reading.description: Whole hours from `last_bucket` to the feed's `generated`. Null when the gap's size could not be computed — never 0 as a stand-in for unknown.

withdrawn.description: True when this cell's last reading did cross a danger floor. The alert built from it is no longer published, so this record withdraws it; it does not report that the danger passed.
